newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks inch higher in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks inch higher in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks inched higher in early morning trade on Friday, supported by strength on Wall Street overnight, brokers said.
However, they said that momentum was likely to be limited ahead of the weekend.
As of 0018 GMT, the Nikkei 225 was 85.25 points, or 0.41 percent higher at 20,856.36. Its December futures were up 60 points at 20,900.
Brokers said November Nikkei stock option settlement-related positions were close to even and unlikely to shake the market greatly.
